title: Seminar in Mediated Communication; Content Creators and the Public Good
description: In this course students consider the relationship between content creation and news, advertising, entertainment media and civic culture through practice. They will create digital content including scripted shorts, infographics, data visualizations, multi-person debates, and more. The class bridges history, theory and practice for students across areas to understand and critique the place of content creation in a 21st century democratic society.
